meta.actor: Claude — consolidation pass (no research, no content rewriting)
meta.scope: Every Grok batch file for Thailand merged into one file. Records are byte-faithful to the batches except for the normalisations listed in _consolidation.

reports.title: National Statistical Office of Thailand (NSO) institutional core
reports.publisher: National Statistical Office
reports.description: Primary national statistical office responsible for censuses, surveys, national accounts coordination, prices, labour, demographic and multi-domain socio-economic statistics. Publishes the Statistical Yearbook and major survey series.
reports._notes: Foundational institutional node for the Thai statistical system.

reports.title: Population census and estimates
reports.publisher: National Statistical Office
reports.description: Official population census and subsequent estimates. Population is approximately 71–72 million; Thailand is an upper-middle-income economy with advanced demographic transition and rising aging.

reports.title: National Accounts of Thailand (GDP)
reports.publisher: Office of the National Economic and Social Development Council (NESDC) / NSO related
reports.description: Official national accounts (GDP by industry and expenditure). Central macro-output series for a diversified upper-middle-income economy with strong tourism, manufacturing and agricultural foundations.
reports._notes: Primary macroeconomic output node. NESDC is the key national accounts compiler.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Commerce / NSO related
reports.description: Monthly CPI and inflation rates. Thailand has generally maintained low-to-moderate inflation relative to many peers in recent years.

reports.title: Bank of Thailand (BOT) institutional and reporting core
reports.publisher: Bank of Thailand
reports.description: Central bank responsible for monetary policy, financial stability, foreign-exchange management and key macro-financial and external statistics. Publishes monetary, banking, exchange-rate, BOP and related series.

reports.title: Balance of Payments and external accounts
reports.publisher: Bank of Thailand
reports.description: BOP and external-sector statistics. Tourism and goods exports (electronics, vehicles, agriculture) are major credits; the external accounts are a central policy focus.
reports._notes: External-accounts node with important tourism and manufacturing signatures.

reports.title: Thailand foundational statistical-system meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from NSO, NESDC and BOT sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding the NSO institutional core, population, national accounts, CPI, BOT institutional role and BOP into the opening foundation layer for Thai research.
reports._notes: Opening integrating node for Thai research.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch

reports.title: Tourism arrivals and tourism revenue statistics
reports.publisher: Tourism Authority of Thailand / Ministry of Tourism and Sports / related
reports.description: Official statistics on international visitor arrivals and tourism receipts. Tourism is a major services credit in the balance of payments; recent years show arrivals in the low-to-mid 30 millions range and revenue in the multi-trillion-baht range.
reports._notes: High-centrality services and external-earnings node. Core uniqueness for Thailand.

reports.title: Industrial production and manufacturing statistics
reports.publisher: Office of Industrial Economics / related
reports.description: Industrial production index and manufacturing output statistics. Key segments include automotive, electronics, food, rubber/plastics, petroleum products and related manufactures that underpin export performance.

reports.title: Labour force and unemployment statistics
reports.publisher: National Statistical Office / Bank of Thailand related
reports.description: Labour-force participation, employment and unemployment rates from the Labour Force Survey. Unemployment is typically very low by international standards (around or below 1% in recent readings).
reports._notes: Primary labour-market statistical product. Structurally low unemployment.

reports.title: ASEAN merchandise trade statistics
reports.publisher: Bank of Thailand / Ministry of Commerce related
reports.description: Merchandise trade with ASEAN partners. ASEAN is a core regional market and production-network partner for Thai manufacturing and agricultural exports.

reports.title: ASEAN membership and regional economic framing
reports.publisher: Government of Thailand / ASEAN
reports.description: Framing of Thailand’s founding membership in ASEAN and its role in regional economic integration, production networks and trade liberalisation. Continuously cited in external and industrial strategy analysis.

reports.title: Thailand tourism–industry–labour–ASEAN densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from TAT, OIE, NSO and BOT sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding tourism arrivals and revenue, industrial production, labour force statistics, ASEAN merchandise trade, and ASEAN membership framing into a coherent activity–services–regional layer.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
National accounts, CPI, BOP and BOT series from Batch 1

reports.title: Agriculture production statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperatives / NSO related
reports.description: Official volume and value statistics for major crops and livestock. Rice and rubber are the two highest-centrality agricultural commodities; other significant products include sugarcane, cassava, palm oil and fruits.

reports.title: Rice production and export statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture / related
reports.description: Focused statistics on rice production, area and exports. Thailand is a major global rice exporter; the crop remains central to rural livelihoods and food-security framing.
reports._notes: Foundational food and export crop node.

reports.title: Natural rubber production and export statistics
reports.publisher: Related agricultural and industry sources
reports.description: Statistics on natural rubber planting area, production (dry rubber content) and exports. Thailand is among the world’s largest rubber producers and exporters; the southern region dominates production.

reports.title: Eastern Economic Corridor (EEC) policy and investment framing
reports.publisher: Eastern Economic Corridor Office / Government of Thailand
reports.description: Flagship regional development and investment corridor covering the eastern seaboard provinces. Targets high-value industries, infrastructure and skills upgrading; continuously cited in industrial, FDI and spatial-strategy analysis.

reports.title: Public debt statistics
reports.publisher: Public Debt Management Office / Ministry of Finance
reports.description: Official statistics on public debt stock, composition (government, SOE, guarantees) and debt-to-GDP ratio. Recent readings place public debt in the mid-60s percent of GDP range.

reports.title: Thailand agriculture–EEC–fiscal densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from agricultural, EEC and fiscal sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding agriculture and rice/rubber statistics, Eastern Economic Corridor framing, and public debt statistics into a coherent primary-sector, spatial-industrial and fiscal layer.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Tourism, industry, ASEAN and macro series from earlier batches

reports.title: Bangkok Gross Regional / Provincial Product
reports.publisher: Office of the National Economic and Social Development Council (NESDC)
reports.description: Official GRDP for Bangkok — the dominant primate-city economy, accounting for a very large share of national GDP through services, finance, trade, tourism and headquarters activity.
reports._notes: Primary primate-city economic node. Highest single provincial share.

reports.title: Provincial and regional product structure framing
reports.publisher: Derived from NESDC Gross Regional and Provincial Product series
reports.description: System-level view of the strong concentration of economic activity in Bangkok and the Central / Eastern seaboard (including EEC provinces), with secondary poles and lagging regions elsewhere. Continuously cited in spatial and development analysis.
reports._notes: Spatial densification frame linking Bangkok, EEC and the rest of the country.

reports.title: Electricity generation and capacity statistics
reports.publisher: Energy Policy and Planning Office / EGAT related
reports.description: Installed generation capacity, power generation by fuel type, peak demand and consumption statistics. Natural gas, coal, hydro, renewables and imports form the mix; power is a critical infrastructure series for industry and tourism.

reports.title: Banking system structure and credit statistics
reports.publisher: Bank of Thailand
reports.description: Statistics on the structure of the banking system, total assets, credit aggregates and related indicators. The system is assessed as resilient with solid capital and liquidity buffers.

reports.title: Non-performing loans and banking asset-quality statistics
reports.publisher: Bank of Thailand
reports.description: System-wide NPL (Stage 3) ratios and volumes. Recent readings place the NPL ratio in the high-2% range; asset quality is closely monitored under SME and consumer credit pressures.
reports._notes: Core asset-quality / risk node for the banking cluster.

reports.title: Thailand Bangkok–power–banking densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from NESDC, energy and BOT sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding Bangkok GRDP, provincial/regional structure framing, electricity generation statistics, banking system structure and NPL statistics into a coherent spatial–energy–financial layer.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
EEC, industry, tourism and macro series from earlier batches

reports.title: Education enrolment and attainment statistics
reports.publisher: National Statistical Office / Ministry of Education related
reports.description: Official statistics on enrolment rates by level and related attainment indicators. Primary enrolment is near-universal; secondary and tertiary participation form the main human-capital expansion margins.
reports._notes: Core education access and human-capital node.

reports.title: Poverty and living standards statistics
reports.publisher: NSO / NESDC related / World Bank-aligned
reports.description: Official and compiled poverty rates and living-standards indicators. National poverty has declined to low single digits on some measures; upper-middle-income poverty lines still show residual double-digit shares, with regional disparities.

reports.title: Thailand free trade agreement network framing
reports.publisher: Ministry of Commerce / related
reports.description: Overall framing of Thailand’s network of free trade agreements beyond ASEAN. Includes bilateral FTAs with Japan, Australia, New Zealand, India, Chile, Peru and plurilateral arrangements such as RCEP and ASEAN+1 frameworks. Continuously cited in trade-diversification and export analysis.
reports._notes: System-level FTA architecture node complementing ASEAN membership.

reports.title: Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) framing
reports.publisher: Governments of RCEP parties
reports.description: Framing of Thailand’s participation in RCEP, the largest regional trade agreement by population and GDP coverage. Complements ASEAN and bilateral FTAs in the Indo-Pacific preferential architecture.
reports._notes: Major plurilateral densification of the external trade architecture.

reports.title: Thailand education–poverty–FTA densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from NSO, commerce and development sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding education enrolment statistics, poverty and living-standards indicators, FTA network framing and RCEP framing into a coherent human-capital, welfare and external-architecture layer.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
ASEAN, tourism, industry and macro series from earlier batches

reports.title: Life expectancy and vital statistics
reports.publisher: National Statistical Office / related
reports.description: Official life expectancy at birth and related vital statistics. Female life expectancy is around 80 years; male around 72 years in recent readings. Thailand has completed the demographic transition and is aging.

reports.title: Defence / military expenditure statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from official budget and international compilations (SIPRI-aligned)
reports.description: Estimates of military expenditure. Continuously referenced in security, fiscal and regional strategic analysis.

reports.title: National defence and security policy framing
reports.publisher: Ministry of Defence / related
reports.description: Policy framing of Thailand’s defence and security posture, including territorial integrity, internal security and regional cooperation. Continuously cited in strategic analysis.
reports._notes: Policy-frame counterpart to the defence budget node.

reports.title: Digital economy and e-commerce framing
reports.publisher: Derived from commerce and platform sources
reports.description: Framing and available statistics on digital commerce, e-commerce platforms and digitalisation of SMEs and retail. Strong growth in online sales volumes is a recurring feature.
reports._notes: Digital densification of the services and commerce cluster.

reports.title: Thailand health–defence–digital densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from NSO, defence and commerce sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding life expectancy statistics, defence expenditure and policy framing, and digital/e-commerce framing into a coherent health–security–digital residual layer.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Population, fiscal, tourism and services series from earlier batches

reports.title: Chonburi Gross Provincial Product
reports.publisher: Office of the National Economic and Social Development Council (NESDC)
reports.description: Official GPP for Chonburi — a core Eastern Economic Corridor province combining deep-sea port (Laem Chabang), industrial estates, automotive and logistics with tourism (Pattaya). Consistently among the largest provincial economies after Bangkok.

reports.title: Rayong Gross Provincial Product
reports.publisher: NESDC
reports.description: Official GPP for Rayong — the industrial heart of the EEC, anchored by Map Ta Phut petrochemical complex, refineries and heavy industry. Frequently ranks among the highest in GPP per capita.

reports.title: Chiang Mai Gross Provincial Product
reports.publisher: NESDC
reports.description: Official GPP for Chiang Mai — the principal northern urban and tourism/services pole, ranking among the larger provincial economies outside the Central–Eastern core.

reports.title: Phuket Gross Provincial Product
reports.publisher: NESDC
reports.description: Official GPP for Phuket — the principal southern island tourism economy. Highly sensitive to international visitor arrivals and a key node in the national tourism statistics.

reports.title: Thailand further-provincial densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from NESDC provincial sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding Chonburi and Rayong (EEC core), Chiang Mai (northern pole) and Phuket (southern tourism) GPP series into a coherent further-provincial layer that complements Bangkok and the earlier EEC framing.
reports._notes: Integrating node for the further provincial densification pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Bangkok GRDP, EEC, tourism and industrial series from earlier batches

_consolidation.json_syntax_repair_note: These batch files were not valid JSON as delivered: "releases_per_year" carried an unquoted text value (missing opening quote), e.g. `"releases_per_year": continuous",`. Repaired mechanically by re-quoting the value verbatim. No number was invented.
_consolidation.cadence_note: A non-numeric cadence text was moved off releases_per_year into _cadence_original verbatim and the numeric field omitted, per the v2 spec (omitted, never null). Needs a human/judgement pass to become a real number.

_normalisation.note: Second pass, 2026-08-18: mechanical alignment to src/lib/types.ts. Nothing researched, nothing invented. Every original value that was replaced is preserved on the record under a key prefixed with an underscore.
rules: jurisdiction_level mapped into the six-value union; the delivered string kept as _jurisdiction_level_original.
domains: format-normalised, then any tag outside the 22 approved values prefixed "proposed:" as the spec directs. No semantic merging was done — that needs your call.

relationship_type: part_of edges moved onto the child node as part_of; contains edges reversed onto the child; produced_by edges dropped (publisher is a string, not a node); related_to / complements held in _dropped as deferred. Off-union values were poisoning every PageRank score with NaN.
last_updated added as null where absent (required field, string|null).
region filled with the country name where it was null or missing.
releases_per_year: unambiguous single-word cadences resolved to numbers; ambiguous text left in _cadence_original and listed under _gaps.unresolved_cadence.
source_kind mapped to official/commercial; delivered value kept as _source_kind_original.
Non-schema keys Grok wrote (shape, notes, referenced_by, ...) renamed with a leading underscore so they are visibly not part of the schema. Nothing deleted.

_gaps.note: What is genuinely missing and cannot be fixed mechanically — this is the research queue, not a defect list.
